summary: A starter REST API for Node.js: it gives a new project user sign-up, login with tokens, email verification and password reset, and user management out of the box, backed by a MongoDB database. It also ships a small command that copies the starter into a new project.

children.name: Web API
children.summary: Receives requests from apps and browsers, checks who is asking and whether the input is valid, and sends back answers.

children.name: Routes
children.summary: The URL map for version 1 of the API: auth, users and the interactive API docs.

children.name: Input checks
children.summary: Joi schemas that reject malformed request bodies, params and queries before they reach the handlers.

children.name: Guards & errors
children.summary: Express middleware for JWT auth and role checks, rate limiting on auth routes, validation, and turning errors into JSON responses.

children.name: Handlers
children.summary: Thin request handlers that call the services and shape the HTTP response.

children.name: Accounts & tokens
children.summary: The actual rules: registering and finding users, issuing and checking login and reset tokens, and sending account emails.

children.name: Database records
children.summary: Mongoose models for users and tokens, plus plugins that add paging and clean JSON output.

children.name: Server setup
children.summary: Starts the server, wires Express with security middleware and Passport, loads settings from the environment, and defines API docs and logging.

children.name: Shared helpers
children.summary: Small helpers used everywhere: an API error type, an async wrapper for handlers, and object picking.

children.name: Project generator
children.summary: The create-nodejs-express-app command that clones this starter into a new folder.
